items.name: Duplicate charge
items.definition: The customer was charged more than once for the same order.

items.name: Unclear pricing
items.definition: The customer could not tell what an item or plan would cost before paying.

items.name: Promo code not applied
items.definition: A valid promotion code was entered, but the discount did not appear on the order.

items.name: Card payment declined
items.definition: The payment was refused at checkout.

items.name: Subscription cancellation
items.definition: The customer asks to end a recurring plan or reports that cancellation did not take effect.

items.name: Invoice error
items.definition: An invoice shows a wrong amount, tax, line item, or billing address.

items.name: Lost parcel
items.definition: The carrier reports the parcel as lost, or tracking has not changed for 10 days.

items.name: Wrong item delivered
items.definition: The parcel contained an item the customer did not order, or a different size or color of the ordered item.

items.name: Delivery window missed
items.definition: The parcel arrived outside the delivery window the customer selected.

items.name: Late delivery
items.definition: The parcel arrived after the latest delivery date shown at checkout.

items.name: Item out of stock
items.definition: An ordered item could not be shipped because it was out of stock.

items.name: Missing parts
items.definition: The parcel arrived without some of the parts listed for the product.

items.name: Defective product
items.definition: The product stopped working or never worked within the warranty period, when used as the instructions describe.

items.name: Product not as described
items.definition: The product differs from its listing in size, color, material, or features.

items.name: Sign-in failure
items.definition: The customer cannot sign in to their account with correct credentials.

items.name: Size guide inaccurate
items.definition: The size guide on the listing did not match the delivered product.

items.name: Email change request
items.definition: The customer asks to change the email address on their account.

items.name: Data export request
items.definition: The customer asks for a copy of the personal data stored in their account.

items.name: Agent was rude
items.definition: The customer reports that a support agent was impolite or dismissive.

items.name: No reply to ticket
items.definition: A support ticket received no reply within the promised time.

items.name: Refund delay
items.definition: An approved refund has not reached the customer within the promised time.

items.name: Damaged packaging
items.definition: The parcel arrived with packaging damage, whether or not the product inside was damaged.

items.name: Two-factor code not received
items.definition: The customer did not receive the sign-in code sent by text message or email.
